description: DiligenceOps: submit a counterparty’s insurance certificate or policy excerpt, as text, fields (insurer, coverages with type, limits and dates, effective and expiry dates, certificate holder, additional insured) or both, with optional requirements (coverages with minimum limits, the work start and end dates, certificate holder, additional insured). The signed report states what the evidence establishes, coverage by coverage with its limits and dates, and what it does not: a required coverage type absent, a limit below the requirement, a policy expired or ending inside the work window, a certificate holder or additional insured that does not match, and a certificate that confers no rights. POST /api/insurance-evidence-check. Reads only the material in the call: no page fetch, no account access, no merchant contact and no money movement. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. The report matches words, figures, dates and named items between the submitted texts; it does not interpret meaning beyond that matching. Contract: /api/diligence-assurance-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/diligence-checks/.

inputSchema.description: Send the evidence, the fields or both.

evidence.description: The insurance certificate or policy excerpt, such as an ACORD 25 certificate, up to 256 KB.

fields.description: The same material as fields. A field given here takes precedence over the document for that element.

additional_insured.description: The additional insured wording, where the certificate has it.

coverages.description: Up to 20 coverages with their limits and dates.

limit.description: The per-occurrence or per-claim limit, for example "1,000,000 USD".

type.description: The coverage type, for example "general liability".

effective_date.description: The policy effective date, for example "2026-01-01".

insurer.description: The insurer or insurers affording coverage.

format.description: html reduces the markup to readable text first. Defaults to html when the text starts with a tag, otherwise text.

label.description: Optional name for the material, recorded in the report.

requirements.description: Optional: what you require, so the evidence can be held against it.

currency.description: Optional currency for a numeric limit.

name: wever_insurance-evidence-check
title: Insurance evidence check
